content: {"like": [], "dislike": ["The film was originally filmed in full screen 4:3, but the 'Special Widescreen Edition' cropped out a portion of the frame, removing content from the bottom of the image.", "The resulting widescreen version is not genuine widescreen but an odd letterboxed frame that appears with black bars on all four sides on modern TVs.", "The aspect ratio of the cropped frame (720x388 or 16:10) is a weird ratio between 4:3 and 16:9, requiring the user to use the TV's zoom function to fill the screen.", "The remastering company’s decision to delete frame content detracts from the film rather than enhance it."]}
